selection_contract.rules: All supplied clauses are AND. all/any accept nonempty condition arrays; not accepts one condition. Object: fields:{nativeField:condition}, is_null, match, types:{publicConcreteType:condition}. Field arguments go in arguments and use its existing schema/defaults. Boolean:eq/ne. Number:eq/ne/in/gt/gte/lt/lte. String/ID:eq/ne/in/contains/starts_with/ends_with, ordinal case-sensitive (case_sensitive:false opts into ordinal ignore-case). Enum:eq/ne/in over all declared values. Native flags also support has_all/has_any over comma-separated declared names. Nullable:is_null; null differs from failed read. Collection:some/every/none over its complete source before display paging. Empty every/none are true; a null collection does not satisfy a quantifier. Unknown reads use three-valued logic; undecidable membership makes the collection unavailable, never an observed empty set. reach:{field, some/every/none, include_self?, arguments?} traverses any public same-type reference/collection with shared cycle/depth/node limits; use parent for ancestors or a declared child collection for descendants. Wrapper items/nodes are display windows: apply where at their source field, not to a returned page. Exact selectors and where intersect. No purpose/category defaults.

capability_meanings.bill_giver: Native IBillGiver: an owner of bills, including Pawn surgery orders as well as worktable production. Not proof of manufacturing capability or executable work.

world_observation.visibility: Visible spawned objects/cells and real contents of visible holders. Hidden objects are not evidence of absence.

tools.name: survey_space
tools.description: Discover a spatial footprint, scoped object counts and current environment together. Resolve names directly. Objects include spatial condition/passage/hazard facets, not full health/work/bed/reservation state; use object inspection for those. Inspect returned coverage; not a safety guarantee.

region.description: Exactly one footprint: near (+radius), rect, room_of, area/zone, or map alone. All boundaries inclusive; nearby is a Euclidean circle, not a square or path distance. Multi-cell Things match any occupied cell.

objects.description: false skips generating the incidental object listing and per-object spatial detail for this read. Environment, gases, hazards, coverage and route segments are always computed. Not-requested objects are not evidence of absence.

select.description: Exact definition names and/or native capabilities. OR within each list, AND between lists. Selection filters objects, never suppresses environmental hazards. {"bill_giver":"Native IBillGiver: an owner of bills, including Pawn surgery orders as well as worktable production. Not proof of manufacturing capability or executable work."}

tools.name: inspect_route
tools.description: Compute a path for actor from its current position or optional start to a destination, together with path and surrounding environment. No preliminary inspect_space/route ID. Objects include spatial condition/passage/hazard facets, not full object state. For a later journey leg, keep actor as the traveller and set start to that leg origin; do not substitute another Pawn as actor to move the origin. Path costs are not ETA; current hazards are not a future combat simulation.

detail.description: Always computes a path. summary/details controls object detail, not path availability. Use summary unless object detail is needed.

actor.description: Travelling Pawn; path traversal rules and costs use this Pawn, regardless of start. Not the recipient.

user.description: Optional recipient Pawn for environmental tolerances, not a replacement for actor and not a carrying simulation.

to.description: Destination object or cell. Object paths use the resolved touch endpoint; inspect returned end_mode and stopping cell.

start.description: Optional hypothetical origin: use the referenced object position or cell instead of actor current position. actor remains the traveller. Does not simulate carrying or a Job.

tools.name: inspect_state
tools.description: Read all supported state facets of 1..8 objects or cells. user is the intended user/recipient; actor is the interacting/travelling Pawn (defaults to user). Returns occupancy, reservation sources, native contextual checks and coverage separately, never universal can_use.

exact_lookup.description: Resolve object targets by exact case-sensitive Pawn.LabelShort / Thing.Label. Search loaded maps when map is omitted; actor/user and cells retain current-map defaults.

include_fogged.description: Explicit visibility policy for object-state reads; default excludes hidden targets.

sections.description: Selected current-state sections; omitted means all native facets. Selection does not claim omitted facets absent.

facets.description: Select physical state facets before reading. Requires state section; omitted retains the full state. Pawn health/skills/work/gear remain independently selected sections. Unselected facets are not observed; environment here is cell state only.

public_query.rules:
Selection: use the canonical fields of the current type. A field on a related type is not a field on its parent. select arrays may combine string field paths and field-selection objects; duplicate or overlapping selections are rejected. String paths include, for example ["definition.def_name","stack_count"]. An object maps each field to true, a child field array, or an options object. Equivalent child selections are {"definition":["def_name","label"]} and {"definition":{"select":["def_name","label"]}}. Use explicit select when configuring relation options. A nonempty object containing only known child field names, with no option keywords, is also a child selection. Do not mix child fields and relation options at the same level; unknown names are rejected rather than guessed. Single related objects accept select/args/on; collections also accept where/aggregate/group_by/order_by/limit/offset. Use on as an object keyed by supported concrete component types, never a type-name string. Each value accepts a field array, a pure field map, or explicit select/on options, using the same selection syntax as related objects. Collection selections do not need items/nodes transport wrappers.
Conditions: where is {field.path:{eq:value}}; clauses AND, with all/any/not for composition. Scalar ops: eq/ne/in/gt/gte/lt/lte/contains/starts_with/ends_with/is_null; case_sensitive:false for text. A condition path cannot cross a collection: use some/every/none with a nested where condition. Single-object conditions accept a child-field map or where:{...}; do not mix child fields and condition options. For example definition:{category:{eq:Item}} and definition.category:{eq:Item} select the same membership. reach:{field:parent,some:{...},include_self:true} traverses a declared same-type relation with cycle/depth limits. Do not infer condition paths from selection paths.
Defaults: selected objects return readable scalars and parameter-free collections; objects without scalars expose related fields. Long descriptions, explicit contents and argument-dependent scans require selection. Collections default to limit20. Pawn inventory/equipment/apparel/carried are direct Thing collections; contents reads a Thing container. Their populations remain distinct, with the same collection operations; tracker traversal is internal. Map selectors accept map_id:current (map root id:current), resolved to the actual ID in scope without a preliminary map lookup. Native visible-record defaults remain in effect.
Measurements: group_by names scalar grouping fields. aggregate defines result aliases, not new source fields: quantity in {quantity:{op:sum,field:stack_count}} is not Thing.quantity. Count measures matching records, not automatically humans, stacks or distinct definitions; sum(stack_count) measures stack units. Aggregates cover all matches before display limits. With aggregate and limit:0, rows/page are omitted because no detail was requested; aggregate completeness is unchanged. Grouped select returns only shared values in rows.values. A varying instance field is null with group_field_varies; selecting stack_count is not a substitute for summing it. Keep overlapping query totals separate; never add the ResourceCounter readout to physical counts.
Validation: a failed batch executes no requests and reports one primary error per invalid request plus the indices that passed validation; passing validation is not a game observation. Evidence: assess each required fact using its effective scope and own completeness. Top-level partial does not invalidate a complete aggregate when only unrelated display fields failed. An incomplete aggregate is not an exact total. Complete aggregates do not prove every detail/group row was displayed: check that collection's page.has_more before claiming a complete list. An unselected field was not read. A returned null must be interpreted using its field semantics and issue path, not treated as zero. A complete zero-match collection is empty only under its own scope and predicate. rows=[] alone can be an undisplayed page with a nonzero complete aggregate. scan_complete describes source coverage; fields_complete describes selected reads; page describes display coverage. Empty results establish no matches for the actual predicate, not the absence of a broader user concept; verify uncertain predicate semantics, without routinely requerying every empty set. Continue only for an unmet requested fact, a relevant unknown or conflicting evidence; preserve known facts when a different field is unavailable. Every request/continuation is a fresh observation. Native capability flags, content categories and cached readout membership have different meanings; no task/category presets are applied. Fields with a value domain follow its operators and declared names; invalid names fail before reads, not as zero matches. Native flags accept comma-separated names and has_all/has_any; case_sensitive:false permits ordinal case folding. describe_query also accepts the listed domain names.

common_fields.description: Verse.Thing instance: may be an item, building, plant, Pawn or other native object, not necessarily an inventory item. id identifies the instance; relations describe containment, not ownership or usability.

fields.name: capabilities
fields.description: Native capability membership shared with spatial surveys. Filter with some/in before aggregation and paging; overlapping capabilities do not imply usability.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Transport metadata; not a native gameplay member.

fields.name: runtime_type
fields.description: Actual CLR class name from GetType().FullName; an exact type, not its base-class hierarchy, faction or construction history.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Native Thing.Label; selected getter only. Interpret null using this member's meaning; an issue at its path means failed/unavailable.

fields.name: stack_count
fields.description: Native Thing.stackCount: units in this instance. count measures records; sum(stack_count) measures units. Non-item Things can also have stack_count.

fields.name: hit_points
fields.description: Native Thing.HitPoints; selected getter only. Interpret null using this member's meaning; an issue at its path means failed/unavailable.

fields.name: max_hit_points
fields.description: Native Thing.MaxHitPoints; selected getter only. Interpret null using this member's meaning; an issue at its path means failed/unavailable.

fields.name: spawned
fields.description: Native Thing.Spawned: this instance itself is spawned on a map. false does not establish that it is outside loaded maps; a containing holder can be on a map.

fields.name: destroyed
fields.description: Native Thing.Destroyed; selected getter only. Interpret null using this member's meaning; an issue at its path means failed/unavailable.

fields.name: ingestible_now
fields.description: Native Thing.IngestibleNow; selected getter only. Interpret null using this member's meaning; an issue at its path means failed/unavailable.

fields.name: faction
fields.description: Native Thing.Faction: the faction that owns this instance, null when it has none. This is the native membership fact. Container membership, position and definition do not establish faction.

fields.name: held_by
fields.description: Nearest containing Pawn along Thing.ParentHolder, so "whose pocket is this in" is a read fact rather than an inference. Not ownership; a loose ground item has no such holder.

fields.name: held_by_faction
fields.description: Faction of the pawn returned by HeldBy. When both are null the instance is simply not carried, which is different from a faction that could not be read.

fields.name: definition
fields.description: Native Thing.def reference; only selected child members are read.

fields.name: stuff
fields.description: Native Thing.Stuff reference; only selected child members are read.

fields.name: map
fields.description: Native Thing.Map: map on which this instance itself is spawned; null when not spawned. For a held instance, map_held may still identify its containing map.

fields.name: map_held
fields.description: Native Thing.MapHeld: map of this instance or its containing holder chain. A non-null value does not imply this instance is spawned; null supplies no map reference, not a caravan identity.

fields.name: position
fields.description: Native Thing.Position, exposed only when this instance is spawned; otherwise null. x/z are map coordinates, y is vertical.

fields.name: position_held
fields.description: Native Thing.PositionHeld, exposed when this instance or an ancestor is spawned; otherwise null. Describes the instance/holder location, not walking access.

fields.name: holding_owner
fields.description: Immediate ThingOwner containing this instance, if any. Container membership is not faction, property ownership or hauling status.

fields.name: parent_holder
fields.description: Native Thing.ParentHolder containment link. Follow actual holder relations to identify a container; the reference alone does not classify a Pawn's faction or identity.

fields.name: inner_thing
fields.description: RimWorld.MinifiedThing.InnerThing; null for other runtime types. Outer and inner identity are not interchangeable.

fields.name: inner_pawn
fields.description: Verse.Corpse.InnerPawn; reference only, null for other runtime types.

fields.name: contents
fields.description: Contents in the contents relation. Read directly as a Thing collection with the same selection, conditions and aggregation as other collections. Preserves this relation's population; an absent container is not an empty collection.

fields.name: storage_group
fields.description: Membership in a storage cell for an EverStorable spawned Thing. Overlaps map membership; not acceptance by current storage settings. Null for held/non-storable objects.

common_fields.description: Verse.ThingDef definition, not an instance. Native category, content category tree and query groups are distinct.

fields.name: def_name
fields.description: Native ThingDef.defName; selected getter only. Interpret null using this member's meaning; an issue at its path means failed/unavailable.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Native ThingDef.label; selected getter only. Interpret null using this member's meaning; an issue at its path means failed/unavailable.

fields.name: thing_class
fields.description: Native ThingDef.thingClass; selected getter only. Interpret null using this member's meaning; an issue at its path means failed/unavailable.

fields.name: category
fields.description: Native Verse.ThingCategory enum: broad definition kind. Building includes natural objects; it is distinct from IsBuildingArtificial, faction ownership and construction history. Content-category memberships are in thing_categories.

fields.name: stack_limit
fields.description: Native ThingDef.stackLimit; selected getter only. Interpret null using this member's meaning; an issue at its path means failed/unavailable.

fields.name: always_haulable
fields.description: Native ThingDef.alwaysHaulable; selected getter only. Interpret null using this member's meaning; an issue at its path means failed/unavailable.

fields.name: designate_haulable
fields.description: Native ThingDef.designateHaulable; selected getter only. Interpret null using this member's meaning; an issue at its path means failed/unavailable.

fields.name: ever_haulable
fields.description: Native alwaysHaulable || designateHaulable; not current pawn-specific reachability, reservation or permission.

fields.name: is_medicine
fields.description: Native definition contains a MedicalPotency base stat; not current treatment eligibility.

fields.name: is_weapon
fields.description: Native attack-capable Item with verbs/tools, excluding apparel. Includes improvised weapons; not an exclusive content category.

fields.name: is_ingestible
fields.description: Native ingestible properties exist; includes plants and non-human food. Not a human-food inventory category. Combine with native Item category when counting food items.

fields.name: count_as_resource
fields.description: Native resourceReadoutPriority != Uncounted. Readout classification, not all possessions or all useful items.

fields.name: thing_categories
fields.description: Native ThingDef.thingCategories content-category memberships. Each ThingCategoryDef has its own defName, label and parent ancestry; these names are not values of ThingDef.category or capability flags.

fields.name: ingestible
fields.description: Native ThingDef.ingestible reference; only selected child members are read.

common_fields.description: Native Verse.Pawn instance, including humans, animals, mechanoids and other Pawn kinds; Pawn does not mean human or colonist. The selected root determines the population; id joins the same instance.

fields.name: is_free_colonist
fields.description: Native Pawn.IsFreeColonist: this pawn is a free member of the player faction. This is the native membership test, not an inference from kind, name or carried items.

fields.name: is_colonist
fields.description: Native Pawn.IsColonist: player-faction colonist. Distinct from IsFreeColonist (a colonist can be a slave or prisoner).

fields.name: is_prisoner_of_colony
fields.description: Native Pawn.IsPrisonerOfColony.

fields.name: is_slave_of_colony
fields.description: Native Pawn.IsSlaveOfColony.

fields.name: guest_status
fields.description: Native Pawn.GuestStatus (Guest/Prisoner/Slave); null when the pawn has no such status.

fields.name: map_id
fields.description: Map ID attached to this Pawn by the selected root. The general pawns root includes held Pawns using their containing map (native MapHeld); this field alone does not establish spawned status. The spawnedFreeColonists root selects only FreeColonistsSpawned; that root membership already establishes spawned free-colonist status. status.position uses the Pawn's own spawned position.

fields.name: inventory
fields.description: Items in this Pawn's inventory, distinct from worn apparel, equipped items and the currently carried Thing. Inventory is a containment relation, not current hauling or faction ownership.

fields.name: equipment
fields.description: Items equipped through this Pawn's equipment tracker, distinct from inventory and worn apparel. Read their definitions to identify weapons.

fields.name: apparel
fields.description: Apparel currently worn by this Pawn, distinct from equipment, inventory and the currently carried Thing.

fields.name: carried
fields.description: The current Pawn_CarryTracker.CarriedThing as a zero/one collection. An empty complete result means no currently carried Thing, not an empty inventory or proof about past/future hauling.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Stable map ID within the save.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Display name; not a unique identifier.

fields.name: is_current
fields.description: Whether this is the currently viewed map.

fields.name: is_player_home
fields.description: Game's player-home map flag.

fields.name: colonist_count
fields.description: Number of spawned free colonists; excludes caravans/prisoners.

fields.name: has_visible_threat
fields.description: Game-provided active visible hostile threat signal, not an overall safety assessment.

fields.name: paused
fields.description: Simulation ticks are paused. The player can still inspect, place plans and issue orders while paused; pause does not disable consultation or establish Pawn task incapability. Recommendations can be planned now and run when simulation resumes.

fields.name: current_map_id
fields.description: Current viewed map; null if none.

NativeMap.id: Transport metadata; not a native gameplay member.
NativeMap.name: Game-derived map summary, using the same reader and meaning as Map.name.
NativeMap.is_current: Game-derived map summary, using the same reader and meaning as Map.isCurrent.
NativeMap.is_player_home: Game-derived map summary, using the same reader and meaning as Map.isPlayerHome.
NativeMap.colonist_count: Game-derived map summary, using the same reader and meaning as Map.colonistCount.
NativeMap.has_visible_threat: Game-derived map summary, using the same reader and meaning as Map.hasVisibleThreat.
NativeMap.haul_destination_manager: Native NativeMap.haulDestinationManager reference; only selected child members are read.
NativeMap.resource_counter: Native NativeMap.resourceCounter reference; only selected child members are read.

ResourceCounter.total_human_edible_nutrition: Native ResourceCounter.TotalHumanEdibleNutrition; selected getter only. Interpret null using this member's meaning; an issue at its path means failed/unavailable.

Status.position: This Pawn's own spawned map position; null when not spawned. A null position does not establish absence from a loaded map or caravan membership.
Status.current_job: Current native job; null when there is no current job. It does not establish health, faction or the reason for inactivity.

Mood.level: Current mood need fraction, not the instantaneous target.
Mood.instant: Game CurInstantLevelPercentage: current instantaneous/target mood from thoughts, not a historical observation.

Faction.def_name: Native Faction.def.defName, for example PlayerColony. A definition name identifies the faction type, not a specific faction instance.
Faction.name: Native Faction.Name: the faction's own display name.
Faction.is_player: Native Faction.IsPlayer: true only for the player's own faction. This is the native membership test for "is this ours"; it is not an ownership guess from inventory, containment or pawn kind.
Faction.player_relation: Native Faction.PlayerRelationKind (Hostile/Neutral/Ally) toward the player faction. Only a relation, not an action or a threat assessment.

Stat.value_text: Game-formatted stat value including its display unit; use with raw value rather than guessing percent units.

ThingReference.id: Transport metadata; not a native gameplay member.
ThingReference.runtime_type: Actual CLR class name from GetType().FullName; an exact type, not its base-class hierarchy, faction or construction history.
ThingReference.definition: Native ThingReference.def reference; only selected child members are read.

IntVec3.x: Native IntVec3.x; selected getter only. Interpret null using this member's meaning; an issue at its path means failed/unavailable.
IntVec3.y: Native IntVec3.y; selected getter only. Interpret null using this member's meaning; an issue at its path means failed/unavailable.
IntVec3.z: Native IntVec3.z; selected getter only. Interpret null using this member's meaning; an issue at its path means failed/unavailable.

ThingOwner.owner: Native ThingOwner.Owner reference; only selected child members are read.
ThingOwner.count: Native ThingOwner.Count; selected getter only. Interpret null using this member's meaning; an issue at its path means failed/unavailable.
ThingOwner.total_stack_count: Native ThingOwner.TotalStackCount; selected getter only. Interpret null using this member's meaning; an issue at its path means failed/unavailable.

ThingHolder.ref: Transport metadata; not a native gameplay member.

ThoughtGroup.mood_offset: Effective mood offset for this group as computed by the game. Do not sum raw memory offsets as a substitute.

Thought.mood_offset: Individual thought offset; grouping/stacking can change its effective contribution.
Thought.age_ticks: Memory age in game ticks; null for non-memory thoughts.
Thought.duration_ticks: Game memory duration in ticks; null for non-memory thoughts.

HealthSummary.health_percent: Game summaryHealth.SummaryHealthPercent: an overall game-computed health indicator. Report it separately from conditions and body-part HP; this read is not a blood-volume measurement. A value of 1 does not establish a cause or a general rule about which conditions affect it.
HealthSummary.pain: Game PainTotal aggregate, distinct from injury severity and health percentage. This aggregate alone does not attribute pain to individual listed conditions.
HealthSummary.bleed_rate: Native BleedRateTotal: blood-loss fraction per game day (60000 ticks). Multiply by 100 for percentage points per game day; never per second. This rate alone is not a computed survival-time estimate.

Condition.severity: Raw Hediff severity; meaning/range depends on its definition. Not a universal 0..1 health fraction.

Trait.degree: Trait variant identifier, not a numeric stat bonus. The game-generated description reports this trait's effects; suppression is separate.

Skill.aptitude: Game skill Aptitude, distinct from learned level, XP and passion.
